build_2D_span_extractor_model: build a BERT-based 2D span extractor model for question answering using AnswerSpanExtractor2DModel
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through AnswerSpanExtractor2DModel with input_ids and attention_mask to get span logits
postprocess_span2d_predictions: postprocess span2D model output to extract top N answer predictions from a passage
